name: Nightfall
tagline: By night the wolves hunt. By day, the village votes.
description: Secret roles on every phone: wolves hide among the villagers, with a seer and a doctor on the village's side. At night everyone picks someone in secret; by day the village votes someone out. The village wins when the wolves are gone; the wolves win when they equal the rest.
howToPlay: Check your card for your secret role. Wolves know each other.
At night everyone taps a face in secret: wolves hunt, the seer looks, the doctor saves.
By day, talk it out and vote someone out. Find the wolves before they outnumber you.

presence.note: The day is spoken: remote players need a call.

settings.label: Flavour
settings.description: The same game, reskinned: names, icons and the narrator change

settings.label: Wolves
settings.description: Auto: 2 for 6–8 players, 3 for 9–11, 4 for 12–16; never more than a third

settings.label: Special roles
settings.description: Each takes a villager's seat; the jester needs 7+ players

settings.label: Reveal roles
settings.description: Show a player's role when they die

settings.label: Ghosts see all
settings.description: Dead players see every role (they must stay silent)

settings.label: Hunches
settings.description: Villagers pick a suspect at night; the anonymous tally shows at dawn

settings.label: Town board
settings.description: Typed posts by day; Auto = on only when remote players have no call

settings.label: Days
settings.description: The wolves win if they survive the last day

settings.label: Narrator
settings.description: The voice that tells the story; No narrator = silent
